properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. Reporter (session 62995724, before the move to flo2.io): "`add_decision` with `status: accepted` + `approver` in one call — no second signing call." NOTE THE CONTRAST, triaged separately: the same evening, on the hosted engine, `approver` was refused by flo2 ("an approval recorded through flo2 is always the signed-in person's own … leave `approver` out"), so the one-call form that worked locally is refused as written on flo2.io.
